svg.title: Dolores Huerta, labor and civil rights leader, dies at 96
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration of a 1960s farmworkers' picket line marching along a California vineyard road against a huge setting sun. A young Dolores Huerta, with long dark hair and a red top, leads the line with one arm raised in front of the sun, followed by farmworkers in work clothes and caps. Vine rows run to the horizon, grape clusters hang in the foreground, and long shadows stretch toward the viewer.
